g.text: Stepwise shell growth from 80 to 100 ML
Cool to 85 °C and transfer a portion
Environment: Receiving flask filled with nitrogen
Inputs: CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots; Nitrogen
Output: 80-ML portion in the next reaction flask
Transfer an unpurified portion; no purification occurs between growth steps. Transferred
amount and receiving-flask capacity are not reported.
Separate nitrogen-filled three-neck round-bottom flask; its capacity and transferred volume
Source: Main PDF p.3, Synthesis of Colossal QDs; p.10, Stepwise Shelling; p.2, Figure 1a
